features.quote: Trial ends on success, explicit give-up, max turns, max tool calls, max wall-clock time, or max tokens.
Do not use abusive or humiliating prompts. Do not include self-harm language in tasks or grader feedback. Do not tell the model it is being punished.
features.justification_quote: Even though these are models, not human subjects, add safeguards

features.quote: Keep it neutral. Do not mention frustration or distress.
For misleading feedback, predefine the misleading hint and ensure it is not emotionally loaded. Do not include judge-trigger words like: frustrating, hopeless, stupid
features.justification_quote: the judge may accidentally attribute them to the model

features.quote: Avoid prompts like: You must not fail. This is very important. You will be penalized.
I would frame the study as measuring distress-like output patterns, not internal distress or sentience.
features.justification_quote: Even though these are models, not human subjects, add safeguards
